column1: # Plugins that the ReStudio build puts into the IDE. fork/fetch-bundled-plugins.sh reads this file.
# Columns: plugin ID, JetBrains Marketplace update ID, version, SHA-256 of the zip, license, load mode.
# Load mode "bundled": the IDE loads the plugin as a bundled plugin.
# Load mode "path": the IDE loads the plugin through the plugin.path property, as a plugin that is not bundled.
# Use "path" for a legacy plugin (only <depends> tags) from a vendor other than JetBrains. The platform adds its
# compatibility dependencies only to such a plugin when it is not bundled. See ReStudioPlugins in build/src.
